limits: va-records concerns personal copies and filing-channel or VA-receipt confirmation. va-str concerns delivery of the complete STR to IPAC. Personal-copy requests or unresolved VA receipt are not prerequisites to delivering an already available complete STR; neither task depends on the other. Filing and care stay available.
No worksheet-specific DD214 split exists; sep-dd214 keeps its accepted service-record review meaning and precedes final processing/checkout.
ret-approval is shared by officer and enlisted paths; branch-only retirement requests are not universal prerequisites and are not linked to the shared item.
sb-start records a proposal and remains usable before approval; sb-run is the participation check that follows written approval.
Optional intent is linked only to the dedicated ITF completion task, never to standard filing.
va-file checks the BDD filing route and has no Part A prerequisite. Part A accompanies an actual BDD submission; completing it is not required to check filing options. Filing and care stay available.
